dialogues.speaker: Afshin
dialogues.text: The flower stands proudly on the top of the hills in Liyue, fluttering in the chilly wind up high. It's every bit as pale as the hair of the goddess who touched it...

dialogues.speaker: Afshin
dialogues.text: Extraordinary as it is, it sells for only 80,000 Mora.

dialogues.speaker: Afshin
dialogues.text: A jar of wine outlasting the years that was graced by the Anemo God's humming. Drink it, and you can chant melodious poems...

dialogues.speaker: Afshin
dialogues.text: Stupendous as it is, it sells for only 200,000 Mora.
